era: Cambridge Dictionary for most of 2019 (Wayback captures Jan and Jul 2019): dark #3d3d3d top bar with the menu button, Dictionary / Translate / Grammar (gold top rule on the current one), Log in, English (UK) and Follow us icons; blue hero with the crest wordmark and 'Make your words meaningful', a wide search box with the dictionary select and gold search button, English–Spanish / Spanish–English / Grammar chips, a gold 'My Dictionary' panel and the 'Explore the Cambridge Dictionary' carousel. The late-2019 redesign (Dec 2019 capture) added Cambridge Dictionary +Plus; the theme follows the Jan-Jul majority layout.
